import random, subprocess, time, sys

# TRACE with a big image and many addresses
import struct
def build(R):
    layout=[{'lo':i,'span':1,'mode':0,'cached':0,'children':[]} for i in range(R)]
    # root covering all
    nodes=[{'lo':0,'span':R,'mode':0,'cached':0,'children':list(range(1,R+1))}]
    nodes+= [{'lo':i,'span':1,'mode':0,'cached':0,'children':[]} for i in range(R)]
    nodes[0]['children']=list(range(1,R+1))
    return nodes
